theorem_title: The full stored pipeline survives a protected-memory update
natural_language_statement:
Let memory $\mu$ store the complete selected-color pipeline for original input $x$, size $n$, and strictly increasing normalized lists $A,B,C$. If $\nu$ agrees with $\mu$ below a stop address at least eight cells beyond the pipeline finish, the same complete stored-pipeline predicate holds in $\nu$.

This preservation theorem allows later reporter scratch updates while keeping the complete selected-color pipeline available.
